east_catalysts_risks.notes: Few items were published inside the 28–30 Oct window. The in-window items are Construction World's 28 Oct pieces on the Blue Line trials and the Pink Line approval. No source confirmed that Blue Line trials actually began or that Pink Line approval came. The Deccan Herald article on the Blue Line returned 403, so only Construction World is cited. The Business Corridor "3 interchanges" lead, the Kasavanahalli LED streetlight lead, the Panathur cremation ground protest lead and the Sumadhura/Iron Hill lead were searched and not found in any indexed source. Search summaries mentioned the Business Corridor first package (about ₹3,348 crore, awarded to SNC, per Deccan Herald) and Sarjapur–Hebbal central approval expected around October 2026, but I did not open those pages, so I made no claims from them. I found nothing in the window on Bellandur/Varthur flooding, Cauvery supply, STRR or suburban rail. The Blackstone lease report is dated 13 Oct, outside the window. Its Bellandur/Panathur location is unverified.

east_launches_prices.notes: No project launch or new phase in East Bengaluru, dated within 28–31 Oct 2026, was found. About 14 searches and 7 page fetches were run. Search results were mostly aggregator and promotional pages, so this does not prove that no launch happened. The RERA portal was not searched directly. Leads not found: Trade Brains Blackstone/Bellandur/Panathur piece, Urban Acres Panathur cremation ground protest, Realty Today Sumadhura–Iron Hill Brewery, PRLog Arvind ITPL, and The Bengaluru Live Kasavanahalli streetlight item. The Sumadhura lease article that did surface is dated Aug 2025 and lists different tenants. IndulgExpress was not opened. The Blackstone lease is Oct 13 background; the source does not name Bellandur, and an unverified Ghar.tv search snippet places it there. Arvind ITPL Whitefield (210 units, 4 towers, 2.7 acres, from Rs 3.42 Cr) was seen on a HomeBazaar page updated 27 Oct, but it shows no RERA number or price basis, so it is not reported as a claim. Other pre-window items that surfaced and were not verified by fetch: Puravankara 5.5-acre Balagere JDA (launch in 6–9 months), Sumadhura 17-acre JDA (4 Aug 2026), Abhee Ventures 45-acre Gunjur township (28 May 2026), Brigade Citrine at Budigere Cross. The Mahindra Lifespace 27 Oct JDA is in North Bengaluru and is out of scope.

metro_watch.notes: Window evidence is thin. Confirmed in-window: Pink Line elevated CMRS clearance reported 29 Oct (Oneindia only; no BMRCL/government release fetched), the CM's 15 Nov PM-visit remark, and the 30 Oct Indiranagar track incident. Not verified: the Deccan Herald 31 Oct Cemindia award story (Deccan Herald returned 403 and the article was not located), the Hindu kidney-transport story, and any Phase 3/Red Line, fare, ridership or K-RIDE items inside the window. No official bmrc.co.in or kride.in pages were fetched. Pre-window items (19 Oct, 9 Oct, 3 Sep) are marked as background. The Green Line, Yellow Line, rolling stock and frequency were not covered.

north_south_west.notes:
The window (28–31 Oct 2026) produced thin results. No new villa, plot or apartment launches dated inside the window were confirmed for the North, South or West focus areas or for Devanahalli, Doddaballapur, Hoskote, Kanakapura Road or Bidadi. Aggregator mentions of a Prestige Devanahalli villa project, Prestige City Bidadi pre-registration, Sattva at Thippapura (Doddaballapur), Puravankara Hennur and Prestige Olive Oak (Yelahanka) are unverified. Rely on none of them without a developer or K-RERA source.

Four of the nine leads could not be confirmed. The Hindu articles (IKEA south store, Pink Line 15 Nov per CM, Jalahalli underpass) were blocked in WebFetch, and no other outlet surfaced for IKEA or Jalahalli. The Pink Line item is covered by Daily Jagran, Elets and Construction World. The Bengaluru Live (Yelahanka SFS 208), NammaWard (Arekere BDA) and Urban Acres (IKEA Konanakunte, 5 Nov) items did not appear in search. The Menafn Digi Yatra item is covered by Curly Tales.

Discrepancies and caveats:
- Sources conflict on the date of the CMRS Pink Line clearance. Daily Jagran says Wednesday, 28 Oct; one search snippet said 8 Oct. I used the Daily Jagran date.
- The 15 November inauguration is "expected" only. Construction World on 28 Oct said no date had been confirmed.
- I did not confirm that the Blue Line trial runs actually began by 31 Oct.
- Deccan Herald was blocked with HTTP 403 for two pages.
- The ArisUnitern/Vaishnavi Arsh Greens press release is dated Sept 2025 and is background only.
- I did not reach rera.karnataka.gov.in, so no RERA number is verified.

social_signals.notes: No public Reddit, YouTube or LinkedIn posts about East Bengaluru property dated 28–31 Oct 2026 could be reached. Reddit fetch was blocked. The YouTube results page returned only footer content. LinkedIn searches returned no posts. Search results were dominated by developer and broker blogs, which are interested parties and mostly undated or older than the window. The only in-window items found are two Construction World news reports (28 Oct 2026) on Blue Line trial-run targets, which come from a news outlet and not from social media. The excerpt fields for these claims contain the article headlines only, because the fetch tool returned summaries instead of verbatim body text. I did not find a verbatim body quote, so treat these as lower-confidence. Nothing here is verified against BMRCL primary sources, and the minister's trial-run target had not been confirmed as met by 31 Oct.
